The '''Hall of Learning''' was a building on the grounds of the [[House Organa (estate)|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lorik]] was one of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who maintained a base there.
